item.title: FPGA Based IBM-PC-XT
item.description:
📝 An example memory write bus cycle timing diagram. The bios, for example, is loaded into an FPGA block ram, so that CPU memory reads will come from that rather than the system SRAM chip. This then means that I have a spare read port on the video block ram that can then be used by the VGA signal generator to display the video memory contents.
